product.description: Superputerile lui au fost un puternic simț al dreptății, convingerea fermă că toți oamenii sunt egali și dorința nestrămutată de a lucra și de a lupta pentru ce este drept. Datorită acestor valori a devenit președintele Statelor Unite ale Americii și a pus capăt sclaviei. A trebuit să facă față unui razboi civil și morții a numeroși soldați, dar nu a renunțat și, într-un final, a obținut egalitatea în fața legii și a tuturor oamenilor din țara sa.

# Little Heroes Book Series: Abraham Lincoln Volume 22

## Discover the Story of Abraham Lincoln

Explore history and learn about integrity with *Little Heroes Vol. 22: Abraham Lincoln*, published by Litera. This book is designed to introduce young readers to one of American history's most pivotal figures, focusing on his powerful character traits and monumental impact on society.

Abraham Lincoln was more than just a president; he embodied an unwavering sense of justice. His deep-seated belief that all people are equal fueled a lifelong desire to work for what is right. The story recounts how these core values propelled him into the presidency of the United States, leading to the end of slavery and confronting the challenges of the Civil War.

Despite facing immense hardshipâincluding civil war battles and the loss of many soldiersâLincoln never abandoned his principles. Through resilience and moral conviction, he ultimately secured equality under the law for every citizen in his country. This volume provides a captivating look at his life journey, perfect for inspiring young minds about justice and perseverance.
